svg.aria-label: Puppeteer's ConsoleMessage.text() renders the object maplibre logged as its minified class name, hiding the tile host so the noise filter cannot classify it and CI fails; resolving each msg.args() JSHandle with arg.evaluate() yields the real error text including the host, which the filter classifies as expected offline noise and the check passes.
